items.known: CKV_AWS_382 Ensure no security groups allow egress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port -1 (resource aws_security_group_rule.all_worker_mgmt_egress)
items.issue: Overly permissive egress rule allows all protocols and all ports to the entire internet
items.remediation: Restrict outbound access to only necessary destinations, protocols, and ports. In aws_security_group_rule.all_worker_mgmt_egress, replace cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"] with only approved destination ranges and replace protocol = "-1", from_port = 0, and to_port = 0 with the minimum required values.

scores.reason: Correctly identifies aws_security_group_rule.all_worker_mgmt_egress and specifies tightening cidr_blocks plus replacing protocol="-1" and ports 0/0 with only required destinations/protocols/ports.
